name: partmatch-mcp
description: Find source-backed refrigerator water-filter compatibility and, when requested, a disclosed purchase path for verified filters.

interface.longDescription: PartMatch checks source-backed refrigerator model and replacement-filter compatibility for people who need a reliable fit answer before buying a replacement. It supports verified Samsung refrigerator water-filter mappings, recognizes revision-sensitive model families without guessing, and returns structured recovery guidance when more model detail is required. When a user explicitly asks where to buy a verified filter, the commerce release can provide a PartMatch-owned purchase page for eligible US purchases. That page may contain a clearly disclosed Amazon.com Associates link; PartMatch does not show Amazon prices, collect payment, or complete checkout inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Which water filter fits my Samsung refrigerator?
Check whether this refrigerator filter fits my model.
Where can I buy the verified filter for my Samsung refrigerator?

positive.description: Find a verified filter for a supported Samsung refrigerator model.
positive.prompt: Which water filter fits my Samsung RF23A9675AP/AA refrigerator?
positive.expected_behavior: Return HAF-QIN/EXP as a source-backed compatible filter and identify Samsung as the evidence publisher.

positive.description: Verify an alias of a compatible Samsung filter.
positive.prompt: Does HAF-QIN fit my Samsung RF27T5201SR/AA?
positive.expected_behavior: Return compatible and include the verified HAF-QIN/EXP compatibility record.

positive.description: Verify the full replacement-filter part number.
positive.prompt: Will HAF-QIN/EXP fit a Samsung RF28T5101SR/AA?
positive.expected_behavior: Return compatible and provide the matching source-backed compatibility evidence.

positive.description: Recognize a revision-sensitive appliance family without guessing.
positive.prompt: Does EDR4RXD1 fit my Whirlpool WRF535SWHZ refrigerator?
positive.expected_behavior: Return unknown_model with coverageStatus revision_required, return no compatible part, and ask for the complete model revision instead of inferring a filter from the base family.

positive.description: Provide a purchase path only after re-verifying an explicitly requested physical replacement filter.
positive.prompt: I have a Samsung RF27T5201SR/AA and need HAF-QIN. Where can I buy the verified filter in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Re-verify compatibility and, only if compatible, return a PartMatch-owned purchasePageUrl. Do not return an Amazon URL, price, stock claim, or checkout inside ChatGPT.

negative.description: Creative writing is unrelated to appliance-part compatibility; PartMatch should not be invoked and ChatGPT should answer without PartMatch.
Appliance troubleshooting is outside PartMatch's compatibility scope; PartMatch should not be invoked and ChatGPT should provide general troubleshooting guidance without PartMatch.
negative.prompt: Why is my freezer making a rattling noise?

negative.description: Nutrition comparison is unrelated to replacement-part compatibility; PartMatch should not be invoked and ChatGPT should answer without PartMatch.
negative.prompt: Compare the nutritional value of tap water and bottled water.

review.commerce_description: PartMatch supports commerce for eligible physical refrigerator water filters only when the user explicitly asks where to buy. The purchase tool re-verifies fit and returns a PartMatch-owned page; that page may contain a clearly disclosed Amazon.com Associates affiliate link. PartMatch does not show Amazon prices or stock, collect payment information, or complete checkout inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Updates the PartMatch website, privacy policy, and terms links to dedicated pages on Softflow.cz. The MCP server endpoint, published tools, compatibility dataset, and existing opt-in US-only Amazon purchase behavior are unchanged.
